mapper.select: SELECT lb.live_broadcast_id, lb.member_id, lb.title, lb.description, lb.status, lb.livekit_room_name, lb.started_at, lb.ended_at, lb.view_count, lb.created_at, lb.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auction a WHERE a.live_broadcast_id = lb.live_broadcast_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) AS item_count, (SELECT p.title FROM auction a JOIN product p ON p.product_id = a.product_id WHERE a.live_broadcast_id = lb.live_broadcast_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.auction_id LIMIT 1) AS first_item_title, (SELECT p.thumbnail_url FROM auction a JOIN product p ON p.product_id = a.product_id WHERE a.live_broadcast_id = lb.live_broadcast_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.auction_id LIMIT 1) AS first_item_thumbnail_url FROM live_broadcast lb ORDER BY lb.created_at DESC
